import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static String[] grid = new String[MAX_N];
    static int[][] scientists_count = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] rescue_count = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] infection_time = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][][][] shortest_path = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static final int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int MAX_NODES = 2 * MAX_N * MAX_N + 2;
    static final int BIG_INF = 1_000_000_000;
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new List[MAX_NODES + 1];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[MAX_NODES + 1][MAX_NODES + 1];
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAX_NODES + 1][MAX_NODES + 1];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAX_NODES + 1];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_NODES + 1];
    static int[] parent = new int[MAX_NODES + 1];

    static boolean build_level_graph(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        dist[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        bfs.offer(source);
        while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int u = bfs.poll();
            for (int v : graph[u]) {
                if (capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && dist[v] == -1) {
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    bfs.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfs_path(int u, int sink) {
        if (u == sink) return true;
        for (int idx = ptr[u]; idx < graph[u].size(); idx++) {
            ptr[u] = idx;
            int v = graph[u].get(idx);
            if (dist[v] == dist[u] + 1 && capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v] > 0 && dfs_path(v, sink)) {
                parent[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean augmenting_path(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[source] = 0;
        return dfs_path(source, sink);
    }

    static void reset_flow() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_NODES; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(flow[i], 0);
        }
    }

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph[u].add(v);
        graph[v].add(u);
        capacity[u][v] += cap;
    }

    static int dinic_max_flow(int source, int sink) {
        int total_flow = 0;
        while (build_level_graph(source, sink)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (augmenting_path(source, sink)) {
                int bottleneck = BIG_INF;
                for (int v = sink, u = parent[v]; v != source; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, capacity[u][v] - flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = sink, u = parent[v]; v != source; v = u, u = parent[v]) {
                    flow[u][v] += bottleneck;
                    flow[v][u] -= bottleneck;
                }
                total_flow += bottleneck;
            }
        }
        return total_flow;
    }

    static int idx(int size, int r, int c, boolean is_right) {
        return r * size + c + (is_right ? size * size : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int limit = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] gridLines = new String[n];
        int[] originX = new int[1];
        int[] originY = new int[1];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            gridLines[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = gridLines[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    grid[i] = (grid[i] == null ? "" : grid[i]) + "Y";
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    grid[i] = (grid[i] == null ? "" : grid[i]) + "Z";
                    originX[0] = i;
                    originY[0] = j;
                } else {
                    grid[i] = (grid[i] == null ? "" : grid[i]) + ".";
                    scientists_count[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String buffer = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = buffer.charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Y' && c != 'Z') {
                    rescue_count[i][j] += c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(infection_time[i], -1);
        }
        infection_time[originX[0]][originY[0]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{originX[0], originY[0]});
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k], ny = y + dy[k];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < n && 0 <= ny && ny < n && grid[nx].charAt(ny) == '.' && infection_time[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    infection_time[nx][ny] = infection_time[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        shortest_path[i][j][ri][rj] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == '.') {
                    shortest_path[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfs.poll();
                        int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
                        if (infection_time[r][c] == -1 || shortest_path[i][j][r][c] < infection_time[r][c]) {
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                                int nr = r + dx[k], nc = c + dy[k];
                                if (0 <= nr && nr < n && 0 <= nc && nc < n && grid[nr].charAt(nc) == '.' &&
                                    (infection_time[nr][nc] == -1 || shortest_path[i][j][r][c] + 1 <= infection_time[nr][nc]) &&
                                    shortest_path[i][j][nr][nc] == -1) {
                                    shortest_path[i][j][nr][nc] = shortest_path[i][j][r][c] + 1;
                                    bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_NODES; i++) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        int source = 2 * n * n;
        int target = 2 * n * n + 1;
        reset_flow();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (scientists_count[i][j] > 0) {
                    connect(source, idx(n, i, j, false), scientists_count[i][j]);
                }
                if (rescue_count[i][j] > 0) {
                    connect(idx(n, i, j, true), target, rescue_count[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        if (shortest_path[i][j][ri][rj] != -1 && shortest_path[i][j][ri][rj] <= limit) {
                            connect(idx(n, i, j, false), idx(n, ri, rj, true), BIG_INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinic_max_flow(source, target));
    }
}
